scope: The 92 surviving d=1 four-factor branches after odd full-support projective reduction.
integrality_lemma: Scale a rational [T:S] to coprime integers. Each delta_i is an integral squareclass representative with v2(delta_i) in {0,1}. If F_i=delta_i*r_i^2 is rationally soluble and F_i is integral, then v2(F_i)-v2(delta_i)=2v2(r_i) is an even nonnegative-compatible integer; hence r_i is 2-adically integral. Therefore every Q_2 branch point has a primitive pair (T,S), not both even, modulo 2^k together with square-root residues satisfying all four congruences.
finite_obstruction: For k=5 (modulus 32), enumerate all primitive (T,S) modulo 32 and precompute delta*r^2 modulo 32. A branch with no simultaneous congruence solution has no Q_2 point and hence no Q point.
credit_boundary: Only absence of a primitive congruence solution modulo 32 eliminates a branch. A mod-32 survivor is not asserted to be Q_2-soluble or rational.
